text_simplified: The hadith speaks of the akhlaq of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and clarifies the importance of *as-salam* (the greeting of peace) as the Muslim’s greeting to whomever he meets.

review_defects.why: The same Arabic term 'السلام' is rendered as 'Peace' in the title but transliterated as 'as-salam' in the body, creating inconsistency in how the Islamic greeting term is presented.
